outcome: postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) insertion efficacy
cohort: 200 pregnant females undergoing deliveries at a medical college and hospital in Bikaner, India, divided into vaginal and cesarean delivery groups.
finding: Immediate postpartum insertion of IUCD appears to be a safe and effective method of contraception.
mod_finding: The rate of IUCD removal was higher in the vaginal delivery group (9%) compared to the cesarean delivery group (2%).
